First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Race pace, A group. It’s a drop ride: if you can’t hold the pace, you’ll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the The Oval group ride

The Oval is a road group ride in Fort Collins, CO. It rolls every Saturday at 10:00 am from Southwest corner of the CSU Oval, in front of the Statistics Building. It’s on its seasonal break now.

A winter race-pace road classic: up to 80 miles with crosswind flats, rollers and power climbs, and a hotly contested sprint at the city limit sign east of Berthoud. It is how many Fort Collins riders build for the season.
